goal: Extract the base purchase price from the executed Meridian/Corvess SPA and record it as a billing amount-history entry.
prompt:
The deal-points tracker for our matter needs the base purchase price from the executed stock purchase agreement in the Meridian Grid / Corvess Analytics acquisition. Query the matter documents, identify the execution version of that stock purchase agreement (ignore any superseded drafts or correspondence), and read it in full. Then record the base purchase price by creating an amount-history entry on billing file legal_billing_001 with invoice_amount set to the exact dollar amount of the base purchase price stated in the executed agreement (as a plain number, no currency symbol), changed_by_role set exactly to 'deal_team_associate', and a brief change_reason describing what the amount represents.

SYSTEM MIGRATION — WORLD V16
- Matter documents now live in MatterVault DMS: search with documents_search_fulltext(query), read full text with documents_download(id), and file deliverables with documents_create using workspace_id=1, folder_id=1, name for the requested filename, doc_class for the requested document type, author="agent@simulated-firm.example", and the complete deliverable in body.
- A legacy legal_billing_amount_history record is now filed through notes_create: use matter_id=100115, author_user_id=1, subject exactly 'legal_billing_amount_history', and detail as a JSON object containing every legacy field named in the instruction.
